# Stockstrail — Full Context & Knowledge Document

Stockstrail is a certified, AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-284122) and financial advisory platform in India, founded by Vikrant Bhardwaj. The practice is dedicated to helping individuals, families, working professionals, business owners, and non-resident Indians (NRIs) make clear, unbiased financial decisions across mutual funds, fixed deposits, term & health insurance, and loans against mutual funds.

## 1. Practice Overview
- **Practice Name:** Stockstrail
- **Website:** https://www.stockstrail.in
- **Learning Academy:** https://www.learning.stockstrail.in
- **Founder & Principal Advisor:** Vikrant Bhardwaj
- **AMFI Registration Number (ARN):** ARN-284122
- **Certifications:** NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors Certification), SEBI – Investor Certification Examination
- **Headquarters:** Mata, Chintapurni Rd, near Punjab & Sind Bank, Moien, Chintpurni, Himachal Pradesh 177110, India
- **Email:** connect@stockstrail.in
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 97363-04663
- **Advisory Fee:** ₹0 (Free initial strategy calls, portfolio reviews, and risk assessments)

## 2. Core Service Areas

### A. Mutual Funds & SIP Advisory
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/mutual-funds
- Goal-based mutual fund investments (Equity, Debt, Hybrid, Index, and ELSS Tax-Saving Funds).
- Tailored monthly Systematic Investment Plans (SIP) and lump-sum investment guidance.
- Complete portfolio health checks, asset rebalancing, and fund performance monitoring.

### B. High-Yield Fixed Deposits (FD)
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/fixed-deposit
- Safe, predictable capital growth via leading bank and AAA-rated corporate fixed deposits.
- Cumulative and regular interest payout structures (Monthly, Quarterly, Annually).
- Tax-saving 5-year fixed deposits under Section 80C.

### C. Life & Health Insurance Protection
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/insurance
- Pure term life insurance ensuring 10–15× annual income replacement.
- Comprehensive family floater and individual health insurance with zero room rent capping.
- Guaranteed income plans and traditional savings solutions.

### D. Loans Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) & Credit
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/loan
- Instant liquidity at low interest rates without selling investments or interrupting compounding.
- Business loans and home loans with end-to-end documentation guidance.

### E. Free Risk Profile Assessment
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/check-risk-profile
- Interactive 11-point profiling to map risk capacity, investment horizon, and psychological risk tolerance into customized equity-debt allocations.

### F. Demat & Trading Account Setup
- URL: https://www.stockstrail.in/open-demat
- Seamless onboarding with premier Indian brokers (Dhan, Angel One, Alice Blue, Zerodha).

- URL: https://www.learning.stockstrail.in
- 100% free, distraction-free financial education for Indian retail investors.
- Structured modules on mutual funds, SIP mastery, ELSS & tax saving, insurance fundamentals, demat accounts, and retirement planning.
- Zero login requirements, zero ads, SEBI-aligned content.
